Converts a raster into a vector of polygons, one for each area of cells with the same value. The no-data cells are not converted.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Vector, Polygons, Conversion<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Vectorizer`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to convert. |
| `pValue` | Double |  |  | The value of the cells to convert, the others become no-data; if not set, all the values are converted. |
| `fDefault` | String |  | `value` | The name of the field of the polygons with the value of their cells. |
| `pThres` | double |  | `0` | The number of cells under which the polygons are discarded. |
| `doRegioncheck` | boolean |  | `false` | First shrink the region to the cells with values, faster on sparse rasters. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outVector` | output file |  | The vector of the polygons. |
